g.title: ESP32
g.text: ESP32 devboard (ESP-WROOM-32, USB-C), socketed on the carrier
Only the pins used on this sheet are shown. USB = micro-ROS link (UART0, 921600). Unused: GPIO36 battery ADC, GPIO39 rain. GPIO2 = status LED.

g.title: HCT245
g.text: 74HCT245 buffer at 5 V (3.3 V in, 5 V out)

g.title: DRV_L
g.text: ENA is not driven by the firmware yet

g.title: DRV_R
g.text: ENA is not driven by the firmware yet

g.title: BLD
g.text: plug-in screw terminals (names from the maker photo). Also F/R, BK, SV, PG, ALM, +5V: use ?; EN level ? (manual not read)

g.title: BLADE
g.text: 8 bare leads, 300 mm; shaft 8 mm D-cut, 25 mm long (maker page); printed blade disc on a flange coupling (to buy)
